sources.label: Resume
sources.content:
ARJUN MENON
Full-Stack Developer · Kochi, India
arjun.menon.builds@example.com · +91 90000 89012 · github.com/arjunmenon

SUMMARY
Full-stack developer with 4.2 years of experience who has built and shipped 14 side projects since 2021 across web,
mobile, data and tooling. I learn a stack by building something small and useful with it.

EXPERIENCE

Tidewave Software — Software Developer                                                Kochi · Aug 2022 – Present
Travel-tech company (hotel booking software).
- Build and maintain a React and Node.js booking platform for 40 partner hotels; page load time dropped from 3.4 s to
  1.6 s.
- Added Stripe test-mode payments and webhooks; payment failures fell from 3.1% to 0.9%.
- Ship features end to end: schema, API, UI and deployment on AWS.

PROJECTS
- SplitEase — Expense splitting for flatmates with settle-up suggestions. React, Firebase.
- ChaiLog — Offline-first ledger PWA for tea-shop owners. TypeScript, IndexedDB.
- PinBoard CLI — Terminal bookmark manager with fuzzy search. Go. github.com/arjunmenon/pinboard-cli
- Campus Carpool — Ride-sharing app for college commuters. Flutter, Firebase.
- Metro Minutes — Next-train API and timetable for Kochi Metro. FastAPI, PostgreSQL.
  github.com/arjunmenon/metro-minutes
- Cinema Pulse — Sentiment dashboard for new film releases. Python, Streamlit.
- FocusTimer — Pomodoro desktop app with weekly stats. Electron, React.
- Notely — Markdown notes with offline sync. Next.js, IndexedDB. github.com/arjunmenon/notely
- CricStats — Interactive IPL stats explorer. D3.js, TypeScript. github.com/arjunmenon/cricstats
- HabitHive — Habit tracker with streaks and reminders. React Native.
- Receipt Reader — OCR for grocery receipts into a spreadsheet. Python, Tesseract.
- Quizzo — Real-time multiplayer quiz. Node.js, WebSockets. github.com/arjunmenon/quizzo
- PortScan Lite — Educational port scanner. Rust.
- Weather Watch — Telegram bot for rain alerts. Python, OpenWeather API.

EDUCATION
B.Tech, Computer Science — Malabar Institute of Technology, Kochi                                    2018 – 2022

SKILLS
Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust (basic), Dart
Web: React, Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, D3.js, PostgreSQL, Firebase
Mobile: React Native, Flutter
Tooling: Git, Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS
